lines: This plan covers 3 days, starting today.
You cook on Sunday, and that is what was kept.
For today, breakfast and lunch are off the plan: the day is already under way.
To stay inside it, expensive proteins give first, then out-of-season produce, then variety — never the portions.

dishes.name: Quick chickpea curry toast
dishes.title: Chickpea curry with wholemeal toast
dishes.method: Reheat one portion of the chickpea curry, then serve with the toast.
dishes.why: A simple regular dinner built around legumes keeps the first day practical and follows Sophia's protein-at-every-meal method.

dishes.name: Savoury tofu toast
dishes.title: Tofu scramble, wholemeal toast and tomatoes
dishes.method: Reheat one portion of the tofu scramble and serve with the toast and sliced tomatoes.
dishes.why: It gives breakfast a recognisable protein food and keeps the morning meal at its usual time.

dishes.name: Curry rice bowl
dishes.title: Chickpea curry with brown rice
dishes.method: Cook the rice in water until tender. Reheat one portion of curry and spoon it over the freshly cooked rice.
dishes.why: The same batch becomes a different lunch by adding freshly cooked whole grain rather than repeating Sunday's plate.

dishes.name: Smoky bean wrap
dishes.title: Smoky black beans, pepper and wholemeal wrap
dishes.method: Reheat one portion of the black bean filling, spoon it into the wrap and fold.
dishes.why: A quick handheld dinner makes the second evening different while keeping beans as the meal's protein anchor.

dishes.name: Tofu breakfast wrap
dishes.title: Tofu scramble, wholemeal wrap and tomatoes
dishes.method: Reheat the final portion of tofu scramble, add it to the wrap with sliced tomatoes and fold.
dishes.why: Changing the format of the same preparation keeps breakfast varied without adding another cooking session.

dishes.name: Fresh bean toast
dishes.title: Smoky black beans with wholemeal toast and tomatoes
dishes.method: Reheat the remaining bean filling and serve it with toast and sliced tomatoes.
dishes.why: The bean batch is used in a new combination on its final safe fridge day, so the lunch stays both practical and varied.

dishes.name: Golden curry flatbread
dishes.title: Chickpea curry with wholemeal flatbread and tomatoes
dishes.method: Reheat the last portion of chickpea curry and serve with the wrap and sliced tomatoes.
dishes.why: It finishes the batch within three days and gives the curry a lighter flatbread presentation instead of repeating the rice bowl.

preparations.title: Two-portion tofu scramble
preparations.method: Dice the onion and tomatoes. Heat the oil in a frying pan, soften the onion for 3 minutes, crumble in the tofu, add turmeric, tomatoes and spinach, and stir until hot and the spinach has wilted. Cool, divide into two portions and refrigerate for Monday and Tuesday.

preparations.title: Three-portion chickpea curry
preparations.method: Dice the onion and courgette. Heat the oil in a saucepan, cook the onion and courgette for 5 minutes, stir in the curry powder, then add the passata and chickpeas. Simmer for 10 minutes, divide into three portions and refrigerate for Sunday, Monday and Tuesday.

preparations.title: Two-portion smoky black bean filling
preparations.method: Dice the onion, pepper and tomatoes. Heat the oil in a frying pan, cook the onion and pepper for 5 minutes, add the tomatoes, black beans and smoked paprika, and cook for another 5 minutes. Cool, divide into two portions and refrigerate for Monday and Tuesday.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Chop all the onions, courgette, pepper and tomatoes first. Start the curry in a saucepan, then cook the tofu scramble in a frying pan while the curry simmers; use the same pan for the black bean filling, divide all three preparations into portions and refrigerate them immediately. Keep the curry and beans for use by Tuesday, and the tofu for Monday and Tuesday.
